# v0.9.0

Gate rule directories in CI, inspect individual rules from saved reports, and scan faster across single instances and multi-tenant fleets.

- `deadair scan --rule` is now repeatable and accepts directories of `.json`, `.ndjson`, `.yaml`, and `.yml` rules. Add `--sarif-out FILE` (or `sarif-out` in the GitHub Action) to write SARIF 2.1.0 for GitHub Code Scanning, and see individual findings directly in the Action job summary.
- `deadair inspect --rule` opens a saved report for one detection by ID or name, showing its verdict, resolved inputs, missing fields, dependencies, provenance, and lag margins without contacting the SIEM.
- `deadair serve` accepts `--json-out` and `--html-out` to keep the latest report on disk without running a second `scan` process against `--state-file`, and re-reads secret, certificate, and fleet files on each scan so rotated credentials take effect without a restart.
- Fleet files support per-instance `policy_file` and `downtime_file` overrides, plus `--fleet-concurrency N` for scanning independent tenants in parallel while keeping deterministic report order. Single-instance scans also parallelize inventory, enrichment, Kibana data views, and deduplicated Sentinel dependency probes.
- Elastic ES|QL rule analysis now covers `INLINE STATS`, `INSIST`, and `TOP` stages. Prometheus metrics add `deadair_source_suppressed` and `deadair_findings_gated` so alert rules honor maintenance windows and accepted findings.
- Static builds embed IANA timezone data for `--downtime-file` on Windows and minimal containers, downtime files reject unknown fields, and source policy entries allow `owner` and `runbook` annotations without overriding `max_stale`.

This release builds with Go 1.27.4, updates dependencies for current Go and `golang.org/x/net` security fixes, and moves the tested CI matrix to Elastic Security 8.19.25 and 9.5.6 and OpenSearch Security Analytics 2.19.7 and 3.10.0. JSON report changes remain additive on `deadair.report.v1`.

See the [usage guide](https://github.com/alephnull-sh/deadair/blob/v0.9.0/docs/usage.md) and [investigation guide](https://github.com/alephnull-sh/deadair/blob/v0.9.0/docs/investigate.md) for examples.
